title: Vu Premium FHD 43-inch (ro.product.model Smart 2K ATV4, device hamamatsucho), India
notes:
Vu Premium FHD 43-inch (ro.product.model Smart 2K ATV4, device hamamatsucho), India
Android TV 9 (SDK 28), firmware PTO4.200424.001; manufacturer reports Hisense.
Live TV app: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter. Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher
(disable it only after the replacement launcher is installed and selected as Home).
Tested on 2026-10-20; the packages below were disabled and the TV remained usable.
Apply: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/vu-premium-fhd-43-hamamatsucho/debloat.txt
Undo:  TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/vu-premium-fhd-43-hamamatsucho/debloat.txt
This deliberately excludes core TV, network, input, Play Store, casting,
streaming and Assistant packages. Restore with the same file if needed.

review.comment: Imported from CleanYourTV examples; checked against policy/critical.json and UAD-ng. Not yet human-reviewed for this repo.
